info.title: claude-profile - create isolated Claude Code profiles
info.description: Create and manage isolated Claude Code profiles, optionally registering dnx-hosted MCP servers.

options.name: --mcp-env
options.description:
copy those environment variables into
that server's env block (repeatable)

options.name: --force
options.description:
overwrite a launcher not created by
this tool

options.name: --help
options.description:
show this help
Environment:
CLAUDE_PROFILE_ROOT   profile root        (default: ~/claude-profiles)
CLAUDE_BIN_DIR        launcher directory  (default: ~/.local/bin)
CLAUDE_EXE            Claude executable   (default: <CLAUDE_BIN_DIR>/claude[.exe])
